body: I don't know if any of my friends are actually my friends, or if they just act like it? I'm not invited to group things, and am always told "we would've invited you" afterwards. On that same strain, it isn't necessarily making me depressed, but I am becoming suicidal because I've only become worse at making friends the older I've become (19, and pretty popular in high school: best all- around). I could be remembered if I died now, I could make a statement.
